title.en: Unify Sprint, Beginner course, SmartCard, and speaking practice
title.zh: 统一今日速成、初级课程、智慧卡与生活口语体验

purpose.en: Create a faster learning rhythm where completing an answer triggers immediate feedback, followed by an intentional Continue step, across SmartLingo’s core learning surfaces.
purpose.zh: 在 SmartLingo 核心学习入口统一采用完成作答即判定、反馈后再继续的更快学习节奏。

en: Auto-score choices when selected and sentence builders when every visible slot is filled.
Keep explicit Continue on feedback states without a separate Check stop.
Add normal and slow model audio plus three scored follow-me attempts to relevant speaking practice.
Use cross-language listening and writing prompts throughout the Beginner five-skill course.
Hold SmartCard Challenge answer feedback for six seconds, then advance automatically without Check or Continue.
zh: 选择答案后自动判定，组句填满全部可见空位后自动判定。
反馈页保留明确的继续按钮，不再增加独立检查停顿。
相关口语练习提供正常与慢速示范及三次评分跟读。
初级五技能课程的听力和写作统一采用跨语言题目与答案。
智慧卡挑战显示答案反馈六秒后自动进入下一题，不显示检查或继续。

en: Today’s Sprint, Beginner vocabulary/reading/writing/listening/dialogue, SmartCard practice and Challenge, Everyday Speaking, sentence grading, and responsive learning controls
zh: 今日速成、初级词汇/阅读/写作/听力/对话、智慧卡练习与挑战、生活口语、组句评分及响应式学习控件

en: Keep anonymous Sprint continuity behind an opaque secure cookie while signed-in learners resume account-owned D1 checkpoints.
Starting from the Sprint picker explicitly replaces the anonymous run; timer extension and refresh retain it.
Prioritize lowest difficulty and highest frequency vocabulary in Beginner and SmartCard learning, and show both metrics.
Score SmartCard pronunciation credit once per card even when all three attempts pass.
Provide microphone-denied fallbacks so learners can record three self-confirmed repetitions without becoming stuck.
zh: 匿名速成使用不透明安全 Cookie 续学，登录学习者则从账户专属 D1 进度续学。
从速成选择器开始会明确替换匿名进度；延长计时和刷新则保留。
在 Beginner 与智慧卡中优先最低难度、同级最高常用度词汇，并显示两项指标。
即使三次发音都通过，每张智慧卡也只奖励一次发音积分。
麦克风不可用时提供三次自我确认跟读，避免流程卡住。

en: Run targeted learning, Sprint, SmartCard, speaking, sentence-catalog, TypeScript, build, migration, sensitive-data, policy, and architecture checks.
Deploy only through GitHub Actions to Cloudflare, then verify production flows and responsive states in a user-facing browser.
zh: 运行学习、速成、智慧卡、口语、组句目录、TypeScript、构建、迁移、敏感数据、政策与架构检查。
仅通过 GitHub Actions 部署至 Cloudflare，再在用户浏览器核验生产流程与响应式状态。

en: Four pre-existing unrelated contract failures remain in Chinese metadata, Clerk navigation, password settings, and a learning-path source assertion.
zh: 中文元数据、Clerk 跳转、密码设置及一项学习路径源码断言仍有四个与本次无关的既有契约失败。

en: Apply proven single-focus exercise pacing while retaining SmartLingo’s own brand, data model, characters, assets, and services.
Preserve Clerk, Cloudflare, AI gateway, commerce, and site-owned data boundaries.
zh: 采用成熟的单题聚焦节奏，同时保留 SmartLingo 自有品牌、数据模型、角色、素材与服务。
保持 Clerk、Cloudflare、AI 网关、商业及站点自有数据边界。
